'''P1-XL''' was a floating cube-shaped [[Droid/Legends|droid]] who was present on<ref name="P1XL" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]<ref name="P1XL" /> around [[3625 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.0}}</ref> P1-XL's plating was a highly visible [[Color/Legends|orange]] color with silver plating around most of the droid's edges, ensuring that his owners would not lose sight of him. The droid had a [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptor]] on the center of one of his side faces and two [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojectors]], one below his photoreceptor, one on his right side, and one on his top face. P1-XL had two vents on his left face and a periscope on his top face.<ref name="P1XL" />

The [[BX-23 Probe Droid]] was identical in shape to the P1-XL droid, but with green plating.<ref name="BX23">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20230503-0|text=Celebrate May the 4th in ''The Old Republic''}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
On [[May 2]], [[2022]], P1-XL was announced to appear<ref name="P1XL" /> in the [[2022]] expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith|''Legacy of the Sith'']] to [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Legacy">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''</ref> The droid was made available as a minipet in honor of ''[[Star Wars]]'' day, [[May 4]], and was gifted to players who logged in between [[May 3]] and [[May 10]] of that year.<ref name="P1XL" />

P1-XL was designed, modeled and animated by [[Bradley W. Lewis]].<ref name="ArtStation">{{ArtStation|username=nonentity|url=artwork/zDRPJw|name=[[Bradley W. Lewis|Bradley Lewis]]|text=SWTOR &#124; P1-XL Boxdroid}}</ref>

The pet shares its model with BX-23, the minipet for ''Star Wars'' day [[2023]].<ref name="BX23" />
